sync_required_response.description: Returned when compute_all returns [] (no requirements at all)
sync_required_response.sample_text:
# Project Needs Sync

The project is linked but has no requirements yet.

Call `sync_project` to sync components and requirements, then `get_next_requirement` again.

all_satisfied_response.description: Returned when compute_all > 0 but next_actionable returns []
all_satisfied_response.sample_text:
# All requirements satisfied

No actionable requirements remain.
